About me

I studied Civil Engineering at Yaba College of Technology and learned the trade on real sites. I have helped with setting out, levelling, measurements, reinforcement works, reading drawings, material checks, quality control and site reports.

I gained that experience at Lagos State Building Control, JAFA Development Venture Consultant Limited and Chi-Gaiffy Builders Enterprise. I care most about building safe, sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and I want to keep growing into technical and leadership roles.

Committed to getting the job done safely, efficiently and beyond expectations.Safe engineering. Quality construction. Lasting infrastructure.
